assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent side-view vehicle sprite for the original game Aliens: Tantalus Frontier.
Create one original MANTA-6 compact industrial deep-sea submersible hull. The existing game prototype is 180 units long by 86 units high; preserve that compact silhouette, with an opaque subject bounding-box ratio very close to 2.093:1. Strict orthographic side elevation, nose pointing right, no perspective yaw, no view of the far side, no floor. The entire hull and all attached parts must fit fully inside the image with a small transparent margin.
Hull design: low compact pressure capsule with an integrated low cockpit canopy on its upper half, one broad pale green smoked-glass window running from the left-middle towards the centre, rounded armoured right-facing bow, integrated small protected stern propulsion at the left. Only a single pilot is implied; no person visible. No fixed gun barrel or torpedo tubes: the game supplies its own separately aimed equipment.
Material and palette: weathered petrol-blue/teal painted steel (#236579 family), restrained pale cyan edge highlights (#92cbd9 family), pale desaturated green window reflections (#b4e3dd family), blackened metal fittings, convincing bolted plates, small panel seams, scuffs and salt-worn edges. Gritty industrial science-fiction realism matching finely rendered 2D game props, legible at 180 x 86 pixels, strong coherent silhouette. Neutral soft overhead lighting, controlled highlights, no dramatic glowing effects.
Background must be genuinely transparent RGBA, including between small appendages. No ocean, bubbles, smoke, wake, seabed, cast shadow, people, text, logo, watermark, labels, or sheet of variants. This is an original Tantalus vehicle design, not a replica of a film vehicle. Produce exactly one complete right-facing hull.

referenceRoles.geometryAndPalette: Legacy procedural hull 180x86, #236579/#92cbd9/#b4e3dd; no detailed canonical hull specified in the bible.

assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent production combat sprite sheet for the original Tantalus character "Matriarche de Soute".
Input image 1 is the existing shared queen sheet, supplied as the anatomy, side-view rendering style and pose reference. Edit it into a dedicated character asset: output EXACTLY FOUR full-body idle poses in a regular 2 by 2 grid, not the original 16-pose grid. Each of the four equal square cells contains one and only one complete creature facing RIGHT.
Preserve the recognizable royal xenomorph anatomy of the reference: broad swept-back cranial crown, elongated eyeless head, biomechanical rib cage, large clawed arms, digitigrade legs, dorsal spines, long segmented tail. Establish a consistent original Matriarche identity in all four cells: charcoal-black heavy chitin, slightly broader crown plate and shoulder armour, rubbed dull silver edges and subtle dusty grey wear consistent with a cargo hold. No added clothing, accessories, weapons or extra limbs. This is an original game variant, not a newly asserted film-canonical design.
The four cells are consecutive restrained idle breathing poses, read left to right then top to bottom: neutral ready stance, tiny chest lift, highest inhalation, relaxed return. Keep feet planted, body scale and identity identical, with only slight torso and hand changes. No walking, lunging or falling poses on this sheet.
Frame geometry is critical: all anatomy including tail, crown and claws stays within its OWN cell, never crossing a grid boundary. At least 6% clear margin around the silhouette. Ground contact is at 91% of each cell height, body core centred near 57% of each cell width. Entire creature around 78% of cell height; do not enlarge one pose relative to another. Tail folds behind toward the left, clear of neighboring frames.
Strict side elevation, realistic hand-rendered industrial-horror 2D sprite quality matching the reference. Crisp detailed silhouette readable at 300 by245 game units, restrained cool highlights, soft neutral illumination. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, including gaps between limbs. No checkerboard painted into pixels, backdrop, ground, shadow puddle, grid lines, labels, captions, text, glow or watermark.

referenceRoles.purpose: Existing anatomy and rendering style; a dedicated original Tantalus identity, not a claim of canonical verification.
